explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/770: h(n) is unbounded for odd n. h(n) is defined as the least m > 2 with gcd(2^n−1, …, m^n−1) = 1. erdosproblems.com/770 says 'mutually coprime', but that cannot be meant literally (3^n−1 and 5^n−1 are both even), so the collective-gcd reading used here is the correct one. The statement asserts that the set of (toNat) values of h on odd n is unbounded. Faithful.
